400.description: Invalid decisions (e.g. a type listed twice)

409.description: A decision was made against an outdated consent text (`consent_version_outdated`)

422.description: Not a PDF/DOCX of the declared size (`invalid_file`)

400.description: No role or level to use (code `profile_required`)

409.description: Wrong status (`content_transition_invalid`), or a publish rule refuses: `rubric_weights_invalid`, `question_rubric_not_published`, `track_has_no_modules`, `track_already_published`, `career_role_has_no_published_level`, or in production an unreviewed AI draft (`content_unreviewed_ai_draft`, overridable with `acknowledge_unreviewed`); or a retire rule refuses because a published role still offers it (`level_in_use`, `stack_in_use`)
Nothing to review — it was not an AI draft, or already is (`content_not_unreviewed`)

400.description: The confirmation word is missing or wrong
